name: DeepSeek Chat

selectors._copyButtonNote: Matches the code-block toolbar buttons; the caller filters by the label so Download is not clicked. .code-info-button-text is the only unhashed class on that control - the rest (ds-button--capsule etc.) are design-system modifiers and the surrounding path is entirely build hashes.
selectors._assistantNote: ds-markdown first: it is the container DeepSeek renders assistant content into. The previous value led with [data-testid] and [class*=message][class*=assistant], which matched three nodes that never update while a reply streams - a build step sat at messages=3, chars=9019 for the full 300s wait because the node being watched was the PREVIOUS answer.

completionRules._maxWaitNote: Raised from 120s. A reasoning model on a plan- or build-sized prompt was still thinking when the old wait expired, so a partial response got extracted and then failed to parse. The wait ends as soon as the reply is complete, so a longer ceiling costs nothing on fast answers.

_controlsNote: DeepSeek has no model dropdown. Two modes and two inline toggles, all reporting their own state. Smart Search exists only under Instant.

controls.label: Deep thinking
controls._defaultNote: Off by default. With DeepThink on, a build-sized prompt spent the whole 300s completion wait in its reasoning phase without starting to answer, so the step timed out and every step behind it blocked. Build steps want a fast structured answer, not a long deliberation. It is one click away in the rail for the cases that want it.

controlSelectors._note: toggle keys off aria-pressed rather than a class: setFlagByText reads that attribute anyway, and .ds-toggle-button stopped matching after a DeepSeek redesign. Unconfirmed against the live site - if the toggles still report unavailable, the run log now prints the page's pressable controls to copy from.
